{{Quote|Karjj was an unlucky sabacc player with a bad temper. His love of the game was not diminished by his frequent losses.|An entry in an artist's journal restored and expanded by the Graf Archive|<ref name="AlienArchive">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref>}}
'''Karjj''' was a [[Crocin]] [[spacer]] active during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Facing financial and [[Marriage|marital]] troubles alike, he was also an enthusiastic [[Gambler|player]] of the [[sabacc]] game, which he enjoyed despite frequently losing [[Currency|money]] in it. In [[10 BBY]], he participated in a [[Corellian Spike]] sabacc game at [[the Lodge]] [[Cantina|saloon]] on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]], where he gnawed his own cards out of agitation. More than [[34 ABY|forty years]] later, a [[bounty]] stemming from various offenses had been posted on the Crocin on the planet [[Batuu]], and the spacer was eventually also highlighted in an entry of an [[Unidentified artist|artist's]] [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]].

==Biography==
Karjj was a [[Crocin]]<ref name="Datapad" /> [[spacer]]<ref name="SoloGuide" /> who hailed from [[Croce]],<ref name="Datapad" /> an [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix Croce">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} — Based on corresponding data for the [[Croce system]]</ref> celestial body that was the [[species]]' [[homeworld]].<ref name="AlienArchive" /> During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], he was plagued by bad luck and had crushing debts and a troubled [[marriage]].<ref name="SoloGuide" /> An avid [[Gambler|player]] of the [[sabacc]] card game, he sought to quickly win prizes by [[gambling]].<ref name="Sticker">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Ultimate Sticker Collection]]''</ref>

[[File:SabaccPlayer.png|thumb|left|300px|Karjj was an avid player of sabacc.]]
In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' featuring the appearance of Karjj to [[10 BBY]].</ref> Karjj participated in a game of<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> the [[Corellian Spike]] variant of sabacc at [[the Lodge]], a [[Cantina|saloon]] in the [[Fort Ypso]] settlement on<ref name="SoloGuide" /> the [[Mid Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix Vandor">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} — Based on corresponding data for the [[Vandor system]]</ref> [[planet]] [[Vandor]].<ref name="SoloGuide" /> Seated between<ref name="Solo" /> the [[Nephran]] [[Thermoculus Krisintvolt Scissorpunch|Therm Scissorpunch]]<ref name="AlienArchive" /> and the game's dealer,<ref name="Solo" /> known as [[Saucer Head]],<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Solo: A Star Wars Story|cardname=Saucer Head|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/176424/cid/11326611}}</ref> Karjj at one point became agitated to the point of placing his hand of cards between his [[Mouth|jaws]] and shredding them to bits. Thereafter the Crocin eventually left the table, with his seat being taken by a [[human]] player.<ref name="Solo" />

By the [[time]] of the [[First Order]] [[Battle of Batuu|occupation]] of<ref name="Datapad" /> the Outer Rim<ref name="Appendix Batuu">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} — Based on corresponding data for the [[Batuu system]]</ref> planet [[Batuu]],<ref name="Datapad" /> in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="GEDates">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]], which includes those of ''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]'', to [[34 ABY]].</ref> a [[bounty]] of nine hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] had been posted on Karjj, who was wanted for outstanding debts and evading arrest as well as a theft of a [[starship]] at Batuu's [[Surabat]] settlement and causing damage to<ref name="Datapad" /> the local [[Stone|rock]]-like spires—in reality, ancient [[Petrified tree|petrified]] [[Batuu tree|trees]].<ref name="BlackSpire">''[[Galaxy's Edge: Black Spire]]''</ref> While Karjj was hiding in one of the buildings of [[Black Spire Outpost]] on Batuu, a visitor to the outpost was assigned his bounty by the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. Using a [[thermal scanner]], they discovered the Crocin's location, which they then reported to the local [[Guildmaster's Hideout]] before collecting the bounty.<ref name="Datapad" /> At some point, Karjj was also mentioned and illustrated in an entry of an [[Unidentified artist|artist's]] [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]] dedicated to the Crocin. The journal was restored, expanded, and displayed at the [[Graf Archive]]<ref name="AlienArchive" /> at some point no earlier than 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]].<ref name="Year">{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
A [[Color|yellow]]-skinned,<ref name="SoloGuide" /> [[Croci]]-[[Language|speaking]]<ref name="Language">{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Language in Star Wars Movies|video=CZp8Civk2co|nolive=1}}</ref> Crocin, Karjj had a short temper that he frequently lost during sabacc games. Coupled with his general distracted nature, it made other players—who expected to quickly part him from his [[Currency|money]]—readily welcome him at a gaming table.<ref name="SoloGuide" /> Although Karjj frequently lost at sabacc, it did not affect his enjoyment of the game.<ref name="AlienArchive" />

==Equipment==
Karjj wore a brown fur-lined [[Clothing|coat]] with a black shirt, brown pants, and a brown [[belt]]. His outfit was complemented by a brown, [[scarf]]-like [[oil]]ed headwrap that prevented his scales from [[Water|drying]] out.<ref name="SoloGuide" /> Like other Crocin, who were not used to bright [[Star|sunlight]],<ref name="AlienArchive" /> Karjj wore a pair of<ref name="SoloGuide" /> thick [[goggles]]<ref name="Sticker" /> to protect his sensitive [[eye]]sight when away from Croce.<ref name="AlienArchive" /> The goggles made his eyes appear glowing yellow in low-light conditions,<ref name="Solo" /> and they also rendered reading his facial expressions during card games difficult.<ref name="Sticker" /> Around 10 BBY, Karjj owned a decrepit starship.<ref name="SoloGuide" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Sure hope your hand's better than his.|Han Solo's representation in a Denny's ''Solo: A Star Wars Story'' tie-in advertisement, to Lando Calrissian's representation on Karjj|<ref name="Denny's">{{OfficialYouTube|channel=@dennys|name=Denny's|video=s8q-y2NkIK0|text=Solo: A Star Wars Story exclusive trading cards, available only at Denny's!|date=2018-04-02|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
[[File:KarrjConceptArt-TheArtOfSolo.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Concept art of Karjj by Jake Lunt Davies]]
Karjj first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Anthology Series]]'' film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Solo" /> which released on [[May 25]], [[2018]].<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> He was portrayed by [[Kiran Shah]]<ref name="Instagram">{{Instagram|username=jakeluntdavies|url=p/BhFRp6cljsy|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2018-04-02|quote=Sabacc playing alien I designed for Solo in new Denny's ad. Performed by Kiran Shah […]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/9Cw1a}}</ref> and was simultaneously named by the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="SoloGuide" /> and [[Beth Davies]]' ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Ultimate Sticker Collection]]''.<ref name="Sticker" /> Karjj was designed by [[Jake Lunt Davies]], who took real-world inspiration from the snouts of [[Wikipedia:Crococile|crocodiles]] and [[Wikipedia:Caiman|caimans]] and the "teeth" of [[Wikipedia:Sawfish|sawfish]]. During the design process, the character, whose resultant snout Lunt Davies characterized as a "[[Wikipedia:Hedge trimmer|hedge trimmer]]–type saw," was nicknamed "Crocamole," and Karjj's early outfit included black [[glove]]s and a [[metal]]lic [[bracelet]].<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> Karjj's model was created by [[Justin Pitkethly]], [[Henrik Svensson]], and [[Steve Wright]].<ref name="InstagramModel">{{Instagram|username=justinpitkethly|url=p/CklSrn0Knau|name=[[Justin Pitkethly]]|date=2023-12-02|quote=While working for Neal Scanlan I sculpted Karjj’s head, hands and feet for “Solo” I made hard foam goggles just for scale, but they were made nicely by the model crew (let me know if you made them or fabricated him etc and I’ll tag you! Designed by @jakeluntdavies painted by @hensvensson “meched” by the amazing Steve Wright who was such a joy to work with, and who we all sadly miss. Brought to life by the brilliant Kiran Shah.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/ns025}}</ref>

Before the film's release, Karjj was also featured in a tie-in advertisement for the restaurant [[Wikipedia:Denny's|Denny's]]. In the advertisement, which was released on [[April 4]], 2018 and re-enacts a different version of the corresponding scene from the film, the Crocin plays sabacc with<ref name="Denny's" /> the [[Danzikan]] [[Lark and Jonk]]<ref name="SoloGuide" /> as well as the advertisement's representations of<ref name="Denny's" /> the humans gambler [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and [[thief]] [[Han Solo]].<ref name="Solo" /> At one point, Karjj slams his hands onto the game table and exclaims in Croci, causing the Lodge's patrons to fall silent and the [[music]] in the venue to stop. With another utterance he then reveals his unsuccessful hand of cards, after which the game goes on without his participation.<ref name="Denny's" />
